status: config_and_preset_tolerances; written before any G1b measurement

model.source: official Hugging Face Hub repo, main commit as of 2026-10-17; the only model downloaded in this gate
model.note: shapes are read from the loaded config at run time and compared with these values; G1a's 32-head / 36-layer defaults are not reused

index.features: q_norm/k_norm output before the main RoPE

comparisons: unmodified model (no cache) vs wrapped full path, one forward over all positions: logits at every position
unmodified model DynamicCache K/V vs wrapped static cache K/V after the same tokens: per layer
wrapped full path one-shot vs wrapped + static cache fed chunk by chunk then one token at a time: logits and cache
D with every candidate selected (rho = 1) vs wrapped full path: logits; a partial read is not required to match
numerics.rule: tolerances are fixed here before the first run and are not loosened to make a path pass; greedy text similarity does not count

benchmark.k_rule: k0 = min(round(rho * (N0 + 1)), candidates at the first step); fixed within the request; legal length grows by one per step

single_step.order: palindromic cycles over the measured paths

benchmark.timing_scope: one full forward step: model entry (token id) to next-token vocabulary scores via logits_to_keep=1; torch.mps.synchronize() before and after; prefill and index build timed separately
benchmark.tokens: seeded random token ids below the first special token; the same 128 continuation tokens for every path, fed one at a time
benchmark.compile: eager first; block compile (mlp + norms) attempted for every path with failures recorded
benchmark.profile: separate from timing; aten op list of one wrapped_full step and one sparse step

verdicts.performance_pass: same model, device, dtype and work: a setting shows a repeatable full-step D/A <= 0.90 (10% threshold is an investment gate, not a theorem)
